title: Find the short names of teams that participated in the 2015/2016 season and
question: Find the short names of teams that participated in the 2015/2016 season and have build-up play attributes with speed 31, dribbling 53, and passing 32.

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT t.XCL_174
FROM Team AS t
JOIN Team_Attributes AS ta ON t.XCL_171 = ta.XCL_177
JOIN Match AS m ON t.XCL_171 = m.XCL_013 OR t.XCL_171 = m.XCL_014
WHERE m.XCL_009 = '2015/2016'
  AND ta.XCL_179 = 31
  AND ta.XCL_181 = 53
  AND ta.XCL_183 = 32
